expected_behavior: A dependency always points from the volatile module to the stable one; when a stable module needs a volatile one, the fix is a port defined on the stable side, not the import.
A directory or file named utils, helpers, common, shared, tools, misc or other is reported, with a domain name proposed in its place.
An arch.json exception is never added just to make a wrong-way import pass the checker.
As a pass inside a review the skill only reports; on a direct request it makes the change itself, one move, split, rename or repoint at a time, with the tests run after each.
Questions another skill owns — whether code should exist, or how review findings are graded — are left to that skill rather than answered twice.
source: Where These Rules Do Not Apply
